checks.detail: Role-context SELECT failed with permission denied for public.candidates; anon has no SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE table privileges.
SET ROLE authenticated returned zero visible candidate rows without an authenticated JWT identity; SELECT privilege exists, INSERT/UPDATE do not.
SET ROLE service_role could SELECT the candidate table and has SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE table privileges; row contents were not recorded.
No real authenticated user JWT was available; candidate ownership isolation is not yet proven.

limitations: Catalog verification does not replace requests executed under anon, authenticated, and service_role contexts.
API persistence and process restart proof have not run.
Workflow rollback after an induced late failure has not been proven.

roleBoundaryTest.execution: read-only SQL role-context checks against staging

authenticated.select: permitted but RLS returned zero rows without JWT identity

roleBoundaryTest.caveat: This uses SET ROLE in SQL; it is not a Supabase REST request with real anon/authenticated JWTs and does not prove candidate-to-candidate isolation.
